purpose: Teach: カントリー/水戸/阪急/ダイエー/那覇/ホワイトハウス/ジョンソン/ブレア

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカントリー音楽の歴史を教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to teach you about the history of country music.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Gentle lilt on Sho's name — drawing him in. Mid-pace. She's delivering information like a gift he might enjoy, not pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと水戸の偕楽園に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to Kairaku Garden in Mito!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Quick attack on the opening. Eager to share what he did. Small voice but genuinely happy — not performing excitement, just genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが阪急電車でお出張なさるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father will be taking a business trip on the Hankyu line.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. A small pause before delivering the news — she's watching for his reaction. Composed but warm underneath, like she's sharing something she's already processed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとダイエー跡地のショッピングモール行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to the shopping mall at the old Daiei site!
lines.style: Quick, bright opening. Similar energy to his first line but slightly more confident — he's sharing another memory he wants her to know about. Genuine warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが那覇の親戚にお会いになるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to meet relatives in Naha.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Slight warmth underneath the practical delivery. She's observing his face as she speaks, gauging how he's taking this news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとホワイトハウスの映像見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a video about the White House!
lines.style: Enthusiastic but measured — not loud. He's noticed something and wants to share it. Genuine curiosity in the delivery, not seeking validation, just including her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジョンソン元大統領の伝記を読んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father has been reading a biography of former President Johnson.
lines.style: Gentle, informative. A subtle warmth in how she's sharing this detail about Ryosuke. Not surprised by him, just noting what he's been doing. Composed delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとブレア元首相のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me a story about former Prime Minister Blair!
lines.style: Warm closing brightness. He's reached the end of what he wants to share and is pleased with himself for listening. Open, uncomplicated happiness. Let the final word breathe slightly.
